violations.text: (Deli meat and cheeses) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the (front counter ) area. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

(deli display ) located in the (front counter ) area was not in good repair. Ambient temperatures observed at 50 DF. Per PIC, unit was in defrost mode. Food was moved to another unit. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep table shelves ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (front counter) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
The (wall ) in the (2 bay sink ) area is in poor repair. Observed a hole The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2026

(Potato Salad), which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours.PIC voluntarily disposed of food product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/22/2025
Bowls were observed in the mop sink. PIC informed and move to warewashing area. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/22/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the (stove vents ) have an accumulation of dust and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 04/22/2025
